title: Weather & Agricultural Spray Advisory
summary_lines: 1. No rain expected over the next 48 hours; skies remain mostly clear.
2. Gentle wind speeds between 8 to 10 km/h make today ideal for foliar spray.
3. Due to midday heat, complete spraying before 10 AM or after 4 PM.
steps: 1. Complete foliar spray in the early morning or evening to prevent evaporation.
2. Add agricultural sticker (surfactant) to improve leaf adhesion.
3. Check soil moisture and provide light irrigation according to crop stage.
speak_text: Today the weather is clear and dry with low wind speeds. It is completely safe to spray in the field this morning or late afternoon.
